title_en: I Want You to Be Only Mine
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear, no author I can name. 'Деј гиди' is my reading as an exclamation of affection.

lines.cyr: Сакам да си само моја, Анѓелино
lines.lat: Sakam da si samo moja, Anǵelino
lines.en: I want you to be only mine, Angelina,

lines.cyr: само тебе јас те љубам, пиле шарено,
lines.lat: samo tebe jas te ljubam, pile šareno,
lines.en: only you do I love, my colourful bird,

lines.cyr: не знајш ти к'о ме опиват, севдо голема.
lines.lat: ne znajš ti k'o me opivat, sevdo golema.
lines.en: you don't know how they intoxicate me, great love.
oh my dear, my dewy clover.
